blocks.text: A percentile is a measure that indicates the value in a dataset below which a given percentage of observations in a group of data falls. For instance, the 25th percentile, also known as the first quartile (Q1), is the value below which 25% of the data points lie. Similarly, the 50th percentile, or the median, is the value below which 50% of the data points lie, and the 75th percentile, or the third quartile (Q3), is the value below which 75% of the data points lie. Percentiles are particularly useful in biostatistics as they help in understanding the distribution of biological data which is skewed or normally distributed.
